entities.name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
entities.description: Captain of the Guard in Paliano, whose sword is pledged to the city's defense rather than to the throne or its usurper.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city of duelists and political intrigue whose throne is contested.

entities.name: Queen Marchesa
entities.description: Ruler of Paliano who uses poison, bribery and intimidation, and believes those who seize power must be able to hold it.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A group that cares not for repentance, only repayment.

entities.name: Sergeant Eyra
entities.description: A sergeant who warns that greed, rage and bloodlust lead to death.

entities.name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
entities.description: A being who speaks of triumph through phyresis.

entities.name: Leshrac, Walker of Night
entities.description: A figure who savors the irony of those who find regret upon achieving their goals.

entities.name: Abrado
entities.description: A Custodi priest who holds that keeping order is too important to relinquish in death.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: A priestly order dedicated to keeping order.

entities.name: Goblin Espionage League
entities.description: A goblin spy organization whose motto is "Infiltrate and infuriate!"

entities.name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
entities.description: A dungeon warden who speaks of the price of revolution and of pillage.

entities.name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
entities.description: A self-proclaimed self-taught genius necro-alchemist.

entities.name: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus
entities.description: Ludevic's creation, brought to life by the necro-alchemist.

entities.name: Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix
entities.description: One who bears the burden of knowing.

entities.name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
entities.description: A dragonspeaker through whom the Great Teacher's voice speaks.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The dragon called the Great Teacher.

entities.name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
entities.description: A usurper who proclaims that the scaled ones rule Tarkir.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A world ruled by the scaled ones (dragons).

entities.name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
entities.description: An emissary of Trest rich in time and money who prefers arrangements to violence.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: The realm Leovold serves as emissary.

entities.name: Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis
entities.description: A pair who fought for and built something together.

entities.name: Academy
entities.description: An institution that came to prefer machines as trainers.

entities.name: Flearan One-Eye
entities.description: A goblin engineer with too many fuses.

entities.name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
entities.description: A nekoru queen, once a fierce foe, who became one of Madara's greatest protectors.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A land Wasitora came to protect.

entities.name: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami
entities.description: A vengeful kami at whose behest the Kami War began.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A war begun at O-Kagachi's behest to regain That Which Was Taken.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: What the Kami War sought to regain.

entities.name: Arathel
entities.description: An elvish queen who vows that what was taken shall be restored.

entities.name: Xun Yu, Wei Advisor
entities.description: A Wei advisor, a splendid talent whose folly lay in serving Cao Cao.

entities.name: Cao Cao
entities.description: A powerful Wei leader whose cousin was Cao Ren.

entities.name: Huang Zhong, Shu General
entities.description: A Shu general who kept the north in fear.

entities.name: Lady Sun
entities.description: Sister to Sun Quan and wife to Liu Bei, whose loyalty to both was often tested.

entities.name: Sun Quan
entities.description: Lady Sun's brother.

entities.name: Liu Bei
entities.description: Lady Sun's husband.

entities.name: Lu Su, Wu Advisor
entities.description: An intermediary between Wu and Shu who became Wu's supreme commander after Zhou Yu's death.

entities.name: Zhou Yu
entities.description: A Wu commander who died in 210 and whose great deed was enabled by Pang Tong's scheme.

entities.name: Wu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Shu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms, served by Xun Yu, Sima Yi and Cao Ren.

entities.name: Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen
entities.description: A warrior queen who led an army against the Shu in place of her husband Meng Huo.

entities.name: Meng Huo
entities.description: Lady Zhurong's husband.

entities.name: Pang Tong
entities.description: A strategist whose boat-connecting scheme let Zhou Yu accomplish his great deed.

entities.name: Sima Yi, Wei Field Marshal
entities.description: A field marshal who fought for four generations of the Cao family; his grandson became emperor and united the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Cao Ren, Wei Commander
entities.description: Cao Cao's cousin, known as the fiercest of warriors across the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Hurloon
entities.description: Peaks that never fall silent.

entities.name: Law of Givesies Backsies
entities.description: A law respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The god of the hunt, who protects those who seek her protection.

entities.name: Kaldrin
entities.description: A jungle sightseer.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The realm through which few names echo.

entities.name: Orlo
entities.description: A goblin raider.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure not all remember with fondness.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A place home to the survivalist Yon Basrel.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A wounded world that can be healed.

entities.name: Aeschel
entities.description: A royal diplomat who sends messages by drake.

entities.name: Mount Zhaoyao
entities.description: A forest of stones near the Western Seas, rich with treasures and strange animals.

entities.name: Western Seas
entities.description: Seas near Mount Zhaoyao.

entities.name: Great Lake of Cloud Dream
entities.description: A lake above which flying fish perform a rainbow ritual dance.

entities.name: Northern Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where yaks channel the powers of the earth.

entities.name: Yinglong
entities.description: The Ancestor Dragon, said to have given birth to the qilin, the phoenix, and all hairy and winged beings.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A traveler (a planeswalker, as fans know) who keeps a travelogue of the Arrow Bamboo Forest and its beasts.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A journal-keeper (a planeswalker, as fans know) who notices a mortal blessed with Qilin's essence.

entities.name: Arrow Bamboo Forest
entities.description: A welcoming-looking but deathly hostile forest whose herds have grown agitated.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: Jiang Yanggu's companion, who sensed danger ahead.

events.quote: "Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
